stage0028_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$アルト$$
「This is bad!
　Damn, that Balarant $$ＰＳ$$ is here too!」

stage0028_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
Firebug Trooper
「Good, we're in combat range.
　Everyone knows their target, right?」

stage0028_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Damn it... why must I go and help
　with a kidnapping...!」

stage0028_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
Firebug Trooper
「You've no right to complain.
　Don't forget who picked you up, $$カン・ユー$$」

stage0028_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「I know that!
　With this $$エクルビス$$ I looted from Balarant
　as severance pay, I'll show my true skill!」

stage0028_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$カレン$$
「Is that $$カン・ユー$$ riding that AT!?」

stage0028_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$クラン$$
「He's still after $$キリコ$$, even now!」

stage0028_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
Firebug Trooper
「Now then, there's only one target...!」

stage0028_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
Firebug Trooper
「We've already looked into it!
　That girl is our new $$姫$$!」

stage0028_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Looks like the enemy's after Jindai High!」

stage0028_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$n, call out $$ジェニオン$$!」

stage0028_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$n
「No good!
　We won't make it in time!」

stage0028_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$$ボン太くん#robot$$ saved us!」

stage0028_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$宗介$$
「This $$ボン太くん#robot$$ is something I prepared...!」

stage0028_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$アルト$$
「Just get that thing off him already!」

stage0028_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「No way!
　It doesn't suit you at all!」

stage0028_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Don't you dare come out!
　You're ruining all that cuteness!」

stage0028_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「But this mismatch of fluff and stone-face!
　It might be something new!」

stage0028_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「While cleaning, I found this
　in an unused warehouse.」

stage0028_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「It's an emergency, so I used it.」

stage0028_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Seems I'm not suited to this machine.
　I'll leave the rest to you.」

stage0028_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$かなめ$$
（Maybe he's more bothered by this
　than I thought...?）

stage0028_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$宗介$$
「Understood.
　I won't waste your assist.」

stage0028_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$スズネ$$
「No good, $n.
　Right now, $$宗介$$ isn't $$宗介$$.」

stage0028_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
Firebug Trooper
「Ha...!
　That rat's entrance left me stunned!」

stage0028_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「What are you talking about!?
　That's clearly a marmot, through and through!」

stage0028_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
Firebug Trooper
「Who cares!
　Let's finish off that fumofumo freak!」

stage0028_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Understood, $$ボン太くん#robot$$.
　Let's protect Jindai High with our strength!」

stage0028_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$... you understand $$ボン太くん#robot$$?」

stage0028_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$アルト$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, Bonta!
　I'm coming now!」

stage0028_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$クラン$$
「I told you to say 'kun', $$アルト$$!
　You forehead dummy!」

stage0028_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$オードリー$$
（What is this, my heart's racing...）

stage0028_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ノイン$$
（Heh... I may dream like a girl again tonight）

stage0028_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Hey, $$カレン$$...
　How many raffle tickets do I need for that?」

stage0028_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$レイ#333$$
（I want to pet something fluffy...）

stage0028_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$スズネ$$
「As always, $$ボン太くん#robot$$'s a big hit.」

stage0028_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$n
「That's only until you learn who's inside, though.」

stage0028_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$カレン$$
「Um... it looked fine on you too, $$ヒイロ$$.」

stage0028_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$さやか$$
「Looks like the enemy's wiped out.」

stage0028_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ボス$$
「Seriously.
　Just when it's finally Sunday,
　these annoying punks show up.」

stage0028_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「It seems $$ファイヤバグ$$ is still after
　$$千鳥かなめ$$.」

stage0028_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「But their goal seems different
　from before...」

stage0028_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Who cares what terrorists think.
　If they come back, we'll crush 'em.」

stage0028_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$くらら$$
「Let's hurry and finish this big cleanup.」

stage0028_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Even after all that commotion,
　$$大貫$$'s still asleep, it seems.」

stage0028_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Looks like Jindai High took some damage too...」

stage0028_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$竜馬$$
「This is bad...
　This is really bad...」

stage0028_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Hurry, everyone!
　Clean it all up before $$大貫$$ wakes!」

stage0028_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Argh, what an unwieldy machine!
　This is why I hate Balarant ATs!」

stage0028_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Remember this, $$キリコ$$!
　The day I master this machine
　will be your death day!」

stage0028_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Can you hear me, Elements?
　Supreme Commander $$不動$$'s left the
　Element Change timing up to you.」

stage0028_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Change Elements as the situation
　demands, and fight!」

stage0028_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$アマタ$$
（I still don't get this world well,
　but if people need our strength,
　we'll fight with Aquarion...!）

stage0028_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$アルト$$
「I have no idea what you're saying!!」

stage0028_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「You sure took care of me at $$ア・コバ$$,
　$$キリコ$$! But today, I'm different!」

stage0028_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「You...!
　Not gonna say a word, huh!」

stage0028_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I've told you many times before.
　I have no words for you.」

stage0028_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「You bastard!!
　How long will you keep mocking me!」

stage0028_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「It's been a while, $$カレン$$!
　I've got plenty of grudges against you!」

stage0028_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$カレン$$
「You're persistent too!
　Still sore about 《$$クメン$$》!」

stage0028_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「That's not all!
　That time, and that time, and that
　time, you turned against me!」

stage0028_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「If you won't kneel and apologize
　for that, I'll crush you right here!」

stage0028_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$カレン$$
「If you're bringing up old grudges,
　I've got something to say too!」

stage0028_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$カレン$$
「How dare you send me out as a
　bunny girl back at $$クメン$$!
　That was sexual harassment, plain!」

stage0028_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「That was an emergency, so...」

stage0028_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$カレン$$
「Shut up!
　I still remember that lecherous
　look in your eyes, even now!!」

stage0028_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I... I have to fight a machine
　with a person inside it...」

stage0028_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$シンジ$$, remember your training.
　You can do it.」

stage0028_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Are you telling me to kill someone!?」

stage0028_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ミサト$$
「That's not it.
　There must be plenty of ways to disable them.」

stage0028_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Center the target, then switch...
　Center the target, then switch...
　Use that to aim for its weak spot!」

stage0028_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ミサト$$
「That's it!
　That training was for a time like this!」

stage0028_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Find your own way, with your own hands!」

stage0028_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Understood, $$ミサト$$...!
　I'll give it a try!」

stage0028_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$n!
　Let's protect the school with our strength!」

stage0028_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$スズネ$$
「What's wrong, $n?
　And here $$竜馬$$ just taught me
　some combat tips, too...」

stage0028_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I can't just keep doing easy
　navigating forever, either.」

stage0028_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$スズネ$$
「What's gotten into you?
　Getting fired up all of a sudden...」
